name: Compact Solar Array
blurb: Lightweight deployable solar wings generating an average of 5 kW.
tradeoff: Generates 5 kW when clear, but output drops sharply during dust storms and winter.

name: Heavy Solar Farm
blurb: Broad solar panel field producing up to 12 kW under clear skies.
tradeoff: Heavy launch mass and yields near zero power when a global dust storm blankets the sky.

name: Kilopower Fission Reactor
blurb: Compact Stirling nuclear reactor delivering 10 kW day and night.
tradeoff: Weighs 6 tonnes, requires an exclusion zone, and risks coolant leaks.

name: High-Capacity Battery Bank
blurb: Adds 120 kWh of energy storage to keep lights on through the night.
tradeoff: Takes up 1.5 tonnes of cargo without generating any new energy.

name: Closed-Loop ECLSS Recycler
blurb: Recycles 90% of gray water and urine, plus partial oxygen scrub.
tradeoff: Draws 3 kW continuously; if power browns out, water recovery halts immediately.

name: MOXIE Industrial O2 Extractor
blurb: Extracts 2 kg of breathable O2 per sol from Martian carbon dioxide.
tradeoff: Draws 4 kW of electricity and wears down high-temperature ceramic cells.

name: Regolith Berm & Shielding Kit
blurb: Bulldozing regolith over the hab slashes daily cosmic radiation by 40%.
tradeoff: At 5 tonnes, it consumes an eighth of your total rocket cargo budget.

name: Water-Jacket Storm Shelter
blurb: Reinforced inner shelter that cuts solar flare particle doses by 70%.
tradeoff: Takes 3 tonnes of mass and cramps the crew during extended solar events.

name: Hydroponic Salad Dome
blurb: Grows fresh greens, providing 3,000 kcal per sol and lifting crew morale.
tradeoff: Drains 3 kW of power and 4 kg of water each sol, and crops can suffer blight.

name: Full Agricultural Biosphere
blurb: Large crop farm producing 7,500 kcal per sol—nearly enough for the whole crew.
tradeoff: Massive 5-tonne weight, 6 kW power drain, and heavy daily water consumption.

name: Precision Spares & Fab Kit
blurb: Replacement pumps, seals, and a 3D printer halve equipment breakdown risks.
tradeoff: 1,200 kg of cargo that does nothing unless machines begin breaking down.

name: Advanced Trauma & Health Bay
blurb: Medical diagnostic gear and drugs to protect crew vitality and treat accidents.
tradeoff: Draws 0.5 kW constantly and takes 400 kg of cargo.

name: Crew Habitat & Rec Module
blurb: Private cubicles, gym equipment, and entertainment to sustain crew mental health.
tradeoff: Draws 0.5 kW continuous power without providing life support or shielding.
